sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Kralim is a lightning-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Vitality (A), Agility (S).

sections.title: Is the Kralim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (A), Agility (S). A dedicated lightning pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
